summary: A Magne is described as a village in south-eastern Laos located near the border with Vietnam. The note places it within Sa Mouay District of Saravane Province. The note is very brief and gives no further details.
one_line: A Magne is a village in south-eastern Laos near the Vietnam border, in Sa Mouay District, Saravane Province.
